name: company-operating-system
description: The whole company, end to end, as one orchestration. Takes a single initiative (a new product / objective) and drives it through every function by NESTING each department's own orchestration as a subflow: discovery → product spec → engineering build (ticket-to-pr) → legal/compliance gate (legal-contract-review) → go-to-market (marketing-campaign + sales-lead-to-close, in parallel) → finance approval (finance-invoice-approval) → hiring to scale (hr-candidate-screening) → support readiness (support-ticket-resolution) → customer-success retention → a locked board readout. Shared run state flows across every subflow boundary, so each function builds on the last. This is the flagship example of composition: it references seven other orchestrations rather than copying them, so editing any one department flow updates the company flow automatically. Look for the 🔗 Nested badge — it's the most-nested orchestration in the set.

inputs.name: initiative
inputs.description: The company initiative to drive end-to-end — a new product, launch, or strategic objective.

phases.name: discovery
